T: Corn for Mum, cucumbers from the stream.
D: Two young sisters who move to the countryside befriend a giant forest spirit.
P: Serve the cucumbers when Granny pulls them out of the cold stream.
S: Iced cucumber spears with a sweet white miso dip
Small cucumbers chilled in iced water, cut into spears and served with miso mixed with a little honey for dipping.
Charred corn cobs brushed with soy and butter
Corn cobs grilled until charred, brushed with butter melted with soy sauce and a little sugar.
lunch on the porch of the old country house

Warm seasoned rice shaped into triangles around flaked grilled salmon or pickled plum, wrapped in crisp nori with toasted sesame. Rinse 2 cups short-grain rice until clear and cook with 2.5 cups water. Grill a 250g salmon fillet sprinkled with salt for 8 minutes and flake. With wet, salted hands, take a handful of warm rice, press a hollow, add salmon or a little pickled plum, close and press into a triangle. Make 12. Wrap the base of each in a strip of nori and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
M: Sticky soy chicken, thin omelette, peas and pickled ginger on rice
Rice with peas, pink fish flakes and a pickled plum, with teriyaki chicken, rolled omelette and pickles in a box.
Satsuki and Mei waiting at the bus stop in the rain

Thick udon in a hot soy and dashi broth with fish cake, a jammy soft-boiled egg, wilted spinach and plenty of spring onion. Boil 4 eggs for 6.5 minutes, cool and peel. Heat 1.2L water with 2 tsp dashi powder, 60ml soy, 60ml mirin and 1 tsp sugar until just simmering. Cook 4 packs (800g) fresh udon in boiling water for 2 minutes and drain. Divide between bowls with a handful of spinach, pour over the hot broth and top with sliced fish cake, a halved egg and sliced spring onion.
W: Small honey pancakes sandwiched with sweet red bean paste

Little honey pancakes cooked golden in a pan, cooled, then sandwiched in pairs with sweet red bean paste. Whisk 3 eggs with 100g sugar and 2 tbsp honey, then 150g flour, 1 tsp baking powder and 60ml water. Cook 16 small pancakes in a lightly oiled pan for 1 minute a side. Sandwich in pairs with 300g red bean paste.
K: Catbus iced barley tea with honey
Roasted barley tea sweetened with honey and lemon, over ice

Toasty roasted barley tea brewed strong, sweetened lightly with honey, chilled and poured over ice with thin slices of lemon. Bring 1.2L water to the boil, add 4 tbsp roasted barley tea (or 3 tea bags) and simmer 5 minutes. Turn off the heat, stir in 2 tbsp honey and steep 10 minutes more. Strain and chill for at least 2 hours. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice, add 2 thin lemon slices to each and pour in the tea.

m.note: Sticky soy chicken, thin omelette, peas and pickled ginger on rice
m.how: Cook 400g sushi rice. Fry 500g chicken thighs, then glaze with 3 tbsp soy and 2 tbsp sugar until sticky. Whisk 4 eggs with a pinch of sugar and roll into a thin omelette in a pan. Pack each box with rice topped with peas, sliced chicken, omelette and pickled ginger.
